cause: The serial helper closed its port after five seconds, about three seconds after the two-second USB countdown; this triggered the firmware USB-host interlock before the later s command.
calibration_persistence_note: Source inspection confirms automatic save_log after stopping includes calibration. No k was sent, but RAM-only calibration was not guaranteed to remain unpersisted once a run completed. Original built-in preset remains 163/160 white,3457/3700 black; drive Profile1 unchanged.
